changelog: Native Police Tape integration with realistic wind sway, sag, and physics collision.
100 built-in tape styles for Police, Sheriff, Crime Scene, Fire/EMS, and Hazard.
In-game Tape Studio to design, preview, and save custom styles in real time.
21 physical holders including delineator post and 20 cones with knock-over physics.
Integrated modern CEF interface for style picker, holders, and HUD prompts.
